reasoning_content: I see - there's a missing TerritoryControl module in the build, and also the PM2 config uses `/opt/areloria` but the files are at `/root/opt/areloria`. Let me check what's happening and fix this, including getting the build to complete.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 -c "
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Check what modules exist
print('=== Server Modules ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('ls -la /root/opt/areloria/server/src/modules/ 2>/dev/null | head -20')

# Check the source file that is missing
print('\\n=== Check TerritoryControl source ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('ls -la /root/opt/areloria/server/src/modules/territory/ 2>/dev/null')

# Check where PM2 is looking for files
print('\\n=== PM2 cwd check ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('ls -la /opt/areloria/ 2>/dev/null || echo /opt/areloria does not exist')

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('ls -la /root/opt/areloria/server/dist/index.js 2>/dev/null')
print('\\n=== Server dist/index.js ===')
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
"
